public_access: Study descriptions, data dictionaries, aggregate variable reports, release notes, repository manifests, SOPs, and linked public repository records are public metadata.
controlled_access: Participant-level phenotype, subject-sample mapping, specimen, aliquot, and molecular data require dbGaP Authorized Access and an approved Data Use Certification.
redistribution: No general redistribution license is stated. This product does not redistribute controlled files, molecular file bytes, images, or whole-slide images.
checksum_policy: Public metadata fixture checksums are pinned. Controlled artifact checksums and sizes remain missing until visible in an authorized repository manifest.
roles: dbGaP applicant and institutional signing official for authorized access
Biospecimen Source Sites as collection sites
Comprehensive Biospecimen Resource as centralized processing and storage site
publisher-declared assay and protocol roles retained without Pathologize reinterpretation
duties: Use controlled data only under the approved research use and Data Use Certification.
Protect participant confidentiality and do not attempt re-identification.
Follow dbGaP acknowledgement and publication requirements.
Obtain separate permission before redistributing source files when the repository terms require it.
